summary: Iteration 30: Dashboard Financeiro and Proposal Restructuring. Backend: 15/15 tests passed - all dashboard, proposal CRUD, PDF generation, and permission APIs working correctly. Fixed bug in update_proposal endpoint that was missing termos_gerais field update. Frontend: All pages load correctly with proper data. Playwright automation limited due to React Native Web TouchableOpacity (known limitation).

integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity components don't respond to standard Playwright click events. This is a known limitation documented in iterations 27-29.
integration_issues.note: Code review confirms all UI elements are correctly implemented. Manual testing or localStorage token injection required for automation.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend update_proposal endpoint was missing termos_gerais field update (server.py line ~3485)
Dashboard API /api/dashboard/summary returns correct structure: bm_by_month (12 months), proposals_by_status, totals, top_clients
Dashboard requires dashboard_access permission - returns 403 without it
Proposal CRUD correctly handles termos_gerais field in create, read, update operations
Proposal PDF generation includes numbered sections, termos gerais section, and observacoes section
Commercial PDF shows prices, Technical PDF does not show prices
Frontend admin index shows Dashboard Financeiro card only when user has dashboard_access
Frontend admins page shows Dashboard permission toggle badge
Frontend propostas page shows filter bar with month/year, status badges, Informar P.O. button, PDF buttons
Frontend dashboard page shows summary cards, BM by month chart, proposals by status, top clients
